blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Asean Parliamentarians for Human Rights (APHR) called on Malaysia to immediately halt the repatriation of Myanmar nationals, warning that returnees could face violence, forced conscription and other serious risks under the military authorities they had fled. Charles Santiago, a former Malaysian lawmaker and APHR co-chairperson, also questioned what he described as an inconsistency between Malaysia’s advocacy against forced displacement in Palestine and its decision to return Myanmar nationals to a country many had fled because of persecution and violence. “Malaysia cannot ask the world to stand with Palestinians while sending Myanmar nationals back to a country many […]...
